skills.name: Temporal Sundial (时汐之晷)
skills.line: A sun lies hidden in my heart.
skills.description: Himiko attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Rewind Time (溯回时隙)
skills.line: I look back at the Castle of the Sun in the torrents of time.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect. Himiko delays 40% of damage she receives until the start of her next turn (the delayed damage is not lethal).
Active Skill: When cast on an enemy target, has a 100% Base Chance of locking them in Time Seam for 1 turn. When cast on an ally, takes them into Rift in Time: if the target is herself, gains 1 stack of Time Radiance and cooldown for 1 turn; if the target is another ally, grants them 2 stacks of Time Radiance. ;Upon Usage :When Himiko uses this skill on an enemy, she has a 100% base chance to banish them into a Time Seam, lasts for 1 turn; when she uses this skill on an ally, grants them access to the Rift in Time on their next turn. ;Time Radiance : :[Buff, Mark] Up to 2 stacks. A maximum of 1 instance of this effect can exist on the ally field, after Himiko casts Timely Sunlight, consumes 1 stack of Time Radiance to make the bearer enter the rift in time. Before the bearer's turn begins, consumes 1 stack of Time Radiance to convert this turn and take them into the Rift in Time. ; : ;Time Seam (时之缝) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Unable to receive move bar changing effects, cannot use normal attacks or special skills outside of their turn.

upgrades.text: Ally's damage dealt in the Rift in Time is increased by 20%.
Time Seam's duration increased to 2 turns.
Ally's damage dealt in the Rift in Time increases to 40%.
'''Upper Hand''': Grants the ally with the highest initial ATK 1 stack of Time Radiance.

bio.condition: Grant allies access to the Rift in Time 100 times.
